Name: unlock
Description: Unlock a file or folder: detect locking processes (handles + loaded DLLs), terminate, fallback to delete-on-reboot

Mcp.Description: Detect and optionally terminate processes locking a file or folder. Without force: detection only, returns status 'needs_confirmation' with lock details. With force: proceeds with graceful shutdown then force termination. Destructive: may kill user processes.

path.description: Absolute path to the file or folder to unlock

force.description: If true, automatically terminate locking processes. If false (default), only detect and report locks.
